angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 576,735 km at 231.99 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.3106 +/- 0.0091 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94): 231.99 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.829 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Sozzetti et al. 2009, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TrES-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract): 576,735 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.928 +/- 0.028 solar masses from Sozzetti et al. 2009, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TrES-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5650 +/- 75 K from Sozzetti et al. 2009, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Sozzetti et al. 2009, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-3 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tres-3.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.569, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-3 (pscomppars): spectral type G4 V, from O'Donovan et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...663L..37O/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-3 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.19 dex, from Sozzetti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-3 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.20412, from Sozzetti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-3 (pscomppars): age 0.9 Gyr, from Sozzetti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-3 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.5 km/s, from Sozzetti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...691.1145S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
